text.title: Residual Instability
text.declared_genre: Indietronica / Dub Electronica / Cosmic Ambient Bass
text.declared_key: F# minor → D minor → E minor, unresolved
text.production_notes: Deep sub as gravitational memory, Dub delays return altered like orbits, Off-grid clock clicks become stellar pulses, Granular relic textures shimmer like cosmic background radiation, Wide rotating pads collapse to mono under pressure, Highs redshift/thin; low mids saturate, Final climax: huge sub, distorted choir, collapsing highs, vacuum dropout, then weightless afterglow, No clean resolution—new law replaces old one,
text.vocal_notes: Intimate androgynous lead; breath-close verses, orbital doubles, low-octave shadows, whispered science fragments, delayed future-self echoes, Vast fragile hooks; near-shouted climax; final exposed solo voice,
section_names: Intro – breath close | distant hiss | faint sub
